jobs.description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.

#### **Location**

This is Hybrid in Mirabel (1-3 Days in a wek). French proficiency Mandatory

#### **About the role you're considering**

We are seeking a Business Analyst to support a business transformation project within the aerospace industry. The successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, project teams, and subject matter experts to understand operational challenges, document requirements, analyze business processes, and support the delivery of business and technology solutions.
  
The ideal candidate possesses strong business analysis skills. The candidate must be comfortable engaging with stakeholders, gathering and documenting requirements, supporting project activities, and contributing to process improvement initiatives while maintaining a strong focus on business value and user needs

#### **Your Role**

* Gather, analyze, and document business requirements, translating business needs into clear functional requirements and user stories.
* Facilitate stakeholder discussions, workshops, and meetings to identify operational challenges, business needs, and improvement opportunities.
* Analyze current business processes, conduct fit-gap assessments, and recommend optimized future-state solutions aligned with organizational objectives.
* Act as a liaison between business, operational, and project teams, ensuring effective communication, collaboration, and stakeholder alignment.
* Support project delivery through planning, risk and issue management, governance activities, status reporting, testing, and user acceptance processes.
* Perform impact assessments, maintain requirement traceability, and evaluate project dependencies, constraints, and business impacts.
* Drive improvements in document management practices, including document control, workflow governance, lifecycle management, and information accessibility.

#### **Your skills and experience**

* Minimum 3 years of experience as a Business Analyst or Functional Analyst.
* Experience participating in business transformation, process improvement, or technology implementation projects.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams and multiple stakeholders.
* Experience facilitating workshops, interviews, and requirements gathering sessions.
* Nice to Have - Experience in the aerospace industry.

In a changing world, unprecedented challenges require unmatched talent. Join one of Montreal's Top Employers in 2025. We are a dynamic and growing organization having its main establishment located in downtown Montreal and part of a leading international banking institution fully committed to building a more sustainable future. Note that the position may be in the Canadian Branch of BNP Paribas or in one of its subsidiaries based in Montreal.

**The position at a glance**

At BNP Paribas, our well-developed Risk management culture is based on a long-term perspective, committed management, and a strong and independent Risk organization led by RISK.

Created at the same time as BNP Paribas, RISK is today a global function present in five continents and at the forefront of Risk management through best-in-class expertise.

RISK is a global, integrated, and independent function.

RISK’s main missions:

* Advise the Bank Management on the definition of risk policy.
* Contribute as a “second pair of eyes” to ensure that risks taken by the Bank are aligned with its policies.
* Report and Alert Bank Management on the status of risks to which the Bank is exposed.

**In detail**

Responsible for risk monitoring and analysis of counterparty risks covering various Capital Markets activities:

* Analyze, monitor and report on market/counterparty risk exposures:
  + Understanding the origin of the exposures (specific trades, products);
  + Designing relevant metrics and stress testing, under both internal and regulatory context;
  + Aggregating and monitoring, across products market risk sensitivities by counterparty, hence providing a transversal view;

* Define / validate / monitor the specific risk framework, e.g., stress testing.
* Engage in active discussions with Trading/Sales and internal RISK stakeholders on risk issues.
* Summarize, escalade and present risk topics to management.
* Leverage technologies and propose initiatives that allow more efficient and automated risk production and analysis.
* Coordinate with other teams and represent the interests of the RISK function in large-scale projects.

* Bachelor’s Degree in Math / Quantitative Finance / Engineering / Economics.
* Minimum of 5 years in risk management/quantitative financing/trading fields
* Knowledge of English is required\*
* In-depth understanding of counterparty/market risk originated from various capital market activities, including derivatives (multi-assets) and securities financing transactions (e.g., Repo, Prime Brokerage);
* Understanding quantitative risk measures and related modeling / methodology (e.g., VAR, PFE, stress testing)
* Strong quantitative skills (Math, Probability/Statistics)

BNP Paribas provides excellent training and personal development programs, as well as opportunities for career development within the company and internationally.

jobs.title: Corporate Coverage Graduate Analyst
jobs.description:
Join one of Montreal's Top Employers in 2026. We are a leading international banking institution fully committed to building a more sustainable future.

Graduate program

The Corporate Coverage Rotational Program is an 24-month program designed for students completing an undergraduate or graduate degree. You will develop both relationship management and credit skills associated with the Marketing / Origination functions of day-to-day Coverage Banker activities.

Upon completion of training, you’ll be assigned to a business sector, where you will assist Senior Bankers (SB) & Marketing Associates, supporting their day-to-day activities, as well as doing client and sector research, performing financial statements and capital structure analysis, creating pitch books, and running initial credit assessments.

Throughout the 24-month rotational program, the analyst will spend some time within the corporate credit management teams ensuring they build the essential credit skills needed to become a successful Corporate Coverage Banker.

More information about the program available on our website: BNP Paribas in Canada Students & Young graduates

**The position at a glance**

Corporate and Institutional Banking is the foundation on which the BNP Paribas Americas relationship franchise is built. Our Global Banking division provides sophisticated and diversified expertise in capital markets, transaction banking, risk management, specialized financing solutions and financial advisory services for our global clients. We combine our global expertise and local presence to better align the complex needs of our multinational clients.

Corporate Coverage North America is responsible for advising large U.S. based corporate clients and delivering an array of the firm's services across strategically targeted client groups in various business sectors.

**In detail**

Analysts will work with Senior Coverage Bankers to own client relationships and better understand a client’s needs, support transaction origination efforts by researching industry-wide financial information, performing financial statement and capital structure analysis of clients, creating pitch books, and initial credit assessments. This role provides an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in client relationship management, financial analysis, and strategic business support within a dynamic banking environment. Additionally, Analysts will:

* Develop strategic sector and/or client presentation materials, with SB guidance and own the pitch book process in close coordination with product teams
* Keep Senior Bankers (SB) & Marketing Associates up to date on all developments (financial and otherwise) in the covered sector(s) and the portfolio
* Maintain databases of client and industry-wide financial information (including internal Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system)
* Develop product understanding and expertise with product specialists
* Contribute to the initial credit assessment to determine the opportunities worth pursuing
* Prepare and facilitate the internal approval of capital allocation via the Resource Allocation Committee (RAC) process
* Prepare and maintain annual client budget in coordination w/the SB, Corporate Platform, and various product areas
* Develop sectorial expertise and serve as internal resource for BNP Paribas globally
* Manage all client matters related to KYC, Due Diligence, Compliance, CSR
* Work on ad hoc projects and deals as needed

**The strengths and skills that will help you succeed**

**ELIGIBILITY:**

* Has graduated less than a year ago or will graduate by June 2027 from an accredited post-secondary program (Bachelor’s /Master’s)
* Has less than 1 year full-time professional experience excluding relevant internship experience
* Excellent academic achievement
* The role may require becoming a Registered Rep with FINRA within 120 days from hired date (not a pre-requisite). The successful candidate is required to complete series exams (SIE, 79, 63) communicated upon hire.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Effective verbal/written communication in English\* and interpersonal skills
* Business degree with a focus on Finance or Accounting
* Entry-level experience in Commercial, Corporate or Investment Banking
* Client relationship skills; ability to articulate ideas well-to clients and colleagues alike.
* Modeling and valuation skills

Gildan is a leading manufacturer of everyday basic apparel, with a strong portfolio of brands, including Gildan®, Hanes®, Comfort Colors®, American Apparel®, ALLPRO™, GOLDTOE®, Peds®, Bali®, Playtex®, Maidenform®, Bonds®, as well as Champion® which is under an exclusive licensing agreement for the printwear channel in the U.S. and Canada.

Together with our global team of dedicated employees, Gildan is united in its vision of Making Apparel Better®. Discover the full scale of Gildan and prepare to be surprised at gildancorp.com.

  
The opportunity:

We are seeking a skilled and proactive Sr. Manager, System Administration to oversee the strategy, deployment, maintenance, and security of our Windows Server and Intel-based physical and virtual infrastructure. In this role, you will lead a global team of systems engineers, manage vendor relationships, and ensure maximum uptime, scalability, and security for our enterprise-level Wintel environment. This is a dynamic opportunity to drive technical excellence and shape the future of our infrastructure landscape.

* Department: IT Infrastructure
* Reporting Into: Director of Infrastructure

The role

* Manages the global engineering team responsible for backups, virtualization, Wintel, and storage design, implementation, and 24/7 operational support.
* Ensures continuous, secure operations by owning ITIL procedures, patching cycles, performance metrics, root cause analysis, disaster recovery plans/tests, and security controls for both in-house and cloud-based services.
* Owns the annual Wintel infrastructure budget by forecasting and maintaining capital and operational expenditures (CAPEX/OPEX), tracking monthly adherence, and identifying cost-saving opportunities across hardware lifecycles and software licensing renewals.
* Manages strategic relationships with third-party service providers, suppliers, and consultants, including vendor selection, contract evaluation, and critical incident escalation.
* Collaborates directly with our PMO and cross-functional IT teams to design, build, and implement robust, enterprise-wide capabilities.
* Partners with functional business areas to ensure all infrastructure solutions meet and scale with current and future business requirements.
* Hires, trains, mentors, and evaluates system engineering talent, establishing clear performance expectations and fostering professional growth.

The requirements

* Education & Experience: A University degree in Information Technology; 12-15 + years of experience in IT infrastructure/architecture, with a minimum of 5+ years in a supervisory or management role.
* Core Technical Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience with the following enterprise technologies:
  + *Operating Systems & Systems Management:* Windows Server (2016 through 2025), Active Directory, Group Policies, SCCM/MECM and Office 365 hybrid environments (OneDrive, SharePoint, Exchange SE).
  + *Virtualization & Storage:* VMware (6.5 through 9.x), Pure Storage, IBM Metro Mirror, and VM stretch clusters.
  + Cloud Infrastructure, Networking & Security: Strong experience in designing and operating enterprise Azure environments. Including Azure networking, hybrid connectivity, identity and Access Management, Workload Management, cloud security and operational governance.
  + *Hardware Ecosystems:* HP, Dell, IBM, Cisco UCS servers, UCS Fabric Interconnects (FI), and Brocade switches.
  + *Availability & Data Protection:* Enterprise backup and disaster recovery planning (DRP) solutions, specifically Commvault.
* Security & Networking (Preferred): Good working knowledge of Cisco ACI, Okta MFA, proxy servers, server hardening, LAPS, CrowdStrike.
* Leadership & Professional Attributes:
  + Thrives as a hands-on manager in a fast-paced, changing environment with the ability to multitask effectively.
  + Demonstrates strong capacity and project planning capabilities to accurately anticipate future infrastructure needs.
  + Operates with complete transparency and collaborates seamlessly across functions to find the best solutions for the organization.
  + Excels at troubleshooting complex systems and possesses a natural curiosity to uncover root causes and drive process improvements.
  + Proven ability to mobilize, motivate, and influence technical teams, proactively bringing the right stakeholders into the conversation.
* Language Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and French.

  
What's in it for you:

* Join a publicly traded company dual-listed on NYSE and TSX with great potential
* Be part of a workplace where meaningful connections and teamwork are celebrated
* From local to international, be ready to work alongside a diverse group of colleagues
* Benefit from mentorship and continuous development opportunities
* Take advantage of our attractive benefits packages

We want to get to know you better! Please include your transferrable skills and unique experience in your application to help us learn more about you.

We thank all applicants for their interest, however, only those selected for interviews will be contacted.

We are committed to ensuring that everyone, across every background and identity, feels respected, supported, and able to thrive. Come as you are and #FindYourFit at Gildan. Tailor the future of your own career.
